body: Implemented: local ONNX embeddings (multilingual-e5-small via optional @huggingface/transformers, chosen by bench/search-eval.mjs), SQLite index in ~/.pman/cache/<projectId>/db.sqlite (WAL), CLI index/search --mode/similar, server API (/api/search?mode=hybrid, /api/search/status, /api/index/update, /api/tickets/:id/similar, POST /api/relations) and UI (search mode label, Enable semantic search, Similar tickets with Duplicate/Relate). See docs/implementation-decisions.md.
